entries.3db5428264138f86: It is a single segment whose main business is the planning, development and sale of toys for young children. All products are manufactured under contract production. By product category, revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥1,391 million for infant, educational and construction toys, ¥11 million for making toys, ¥42 million for other products (play equipment, vehicles, childcare-related products, etc.), and ¥167 million for overseas sales and royalty income. Representative products include the magnetic building block “Pitagorasu” series and the “Yaritai Hodai” series; in May 2025 it released the new “1curiosity” series, and in October it launched “Sawaru TECH,” a digital educational service for young children.
